name: TOMOO no MV Hinpyoukai ~ 2nd Album 「DEAR MYSTERIES」-hen~
overview: TOMOO releases his 2nd Album “DEAR MYSTERIES” on Wednesday, November 12th!To commemorate this, Space Shower TV will air a special program!In the program, TOMOO will personally select three music videos from his new album. He'll share his thoughts from that time and behind-the-scenes stories while giving a self-guided commentary...?Along with the highlights of the music videos, this special feature offers a glimpse into TOMOO's sensibilities and his true self!
